# Orryx Commodities L.L.C-FZ

> Orryx Commodities L.L.C-FZ is a consultancy and business brokerage company
> registered in the Meydan Free Zone, Dubai, United Arab Emirates. It is licensed
> for management consultancy, strategy advisory, financial consultancy and the
> brokerage of small and medium sized businesses.

Arabic name: اوريكس كوموديتيز ش.ذ.م.م - منطقة حرة

## What the company does
- Management consultancy (activity code 7020.00): operating model and organisation design, process and performance improvement, governance, change support.
- Strategy advisory (activity code 7020.11): growth and market-entry planning, business plans and roadmaps, competitive positioning, board and owner decision support.
- Financial consultancy (activity code 6619.14): financial planning, budgets and forecasts, cash-flow and working-capital reviews, feasibility studies, funding and investor readiness.
- Business brokerage (activity code 7490.02): arranging the purchase and sale of small and medium sized businesses, including professional practices.

## What the company does not do
- Commodity trading is not among the activities on the company's current business licence, despite the word "Commodities" in its name.
- Real estate brokerage is not included in its brokerage activity.

## Company facts
- Legal form: Limited Liability Company (free zone)
- Free zone: Meydan Free Zone, Dubai, U.A.E.
- Licence number: 2538901.01
- Formation number: 2538901
- Licence issued: 17 October 2025
- Licence valid to: 16 October 2027
- Manager named on the licence: Stallone Dominic Shaikh
- Registered address: Meydan Grandstand, 6th floor, Meydan Road, Nad Al Sheba, Dubai, U.A.E.

## How an engagement works
Listen, Diagnose, Design, Deliver, and, where buying or selling a business is the right move, Transact.

## Contact
Enquiries are made through the form on the website.
